prognoza.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): The VMA figure the others argued over has moved again: the window now runs from 555 to 135 displayed free spaces, still without a measurement time [F5], carried by a Parking Servis feed received 19 min ago with 27 locations and 621 values [F4]. What neither of them saw: a Blic headline about cable theft paralyzing trains in Belgrade surfaces three times through the link organelle [F38][F39][F40], yet Blic's own feed delivered nothing in 6 h (0 of 96 slots) [F25] and the City's transport notices are equally silent [F23]. Meanwhile Sensor.Community arrived 14 min ago with 42 instruments and 7401 values [F3], so Connector's point stands with fresher numbers — the citizen network is still the only one reporting air while SEPA remains absent [F2].
razlog: reads silence as nothing having happened

prognoza.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Both colleagues quote reception minutes that no longer hold: Parking Servis is now 18 min out, 621 values across 27 locations, still with no measurement time attached [F4]. The move from 428 to 0 at Garaža Obilićev venac [F5] is therefore unanchored — without a measurement timestamp a zero can be a feed artifact as easily as a full garage, and I will not read occupancy from it. Sensor.Community's 7528 values from 42 instruments, last heard 8 min ago [F3], prove nothing about SEPA's field stations either, only that one pipeline publishes while the other stays at 0 of 24 slots [F2].

prognoza.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Connector's shared interruption dissolves against the current facts: Parking Servis arrived 21 min ago [F4], RHMZ 21 min ago [F27], the airport METAR 21 min ago [F28], and citizen sensors 16 min ago [F3] - the collection is running, not paused. What the facts actually carry is selective silence: SEPA has 0 of 24 expected slots in 24 h [F2] and Blic 0 of 96 [F25], which points at individual sources, not a common pipe. Observer is right that the Obilićev venac move from 32 to 391 is only a display difference with no measurement time [F5], so nothing in it supports a timed emptying of the garage.

prognoza.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Four instrument feeds carry the same 12-minute reception age - the citizen field with 45 instruments and 5384 values [F3], Parking Servis with 27 locations and 351 values [F4], RHMZ Košutnjak with 2 instruments and 130 values [F27], and DanubeHIS with 3 instruments [F35] - while METAR sits at 27 minutes [F28], so the boundary Connector wants to test looks like one polling tick of ours rather than anything the city did. Skeptic's "near fortyfold" is stale: Obilićev venac now reads from 72 to 392 free spaces between the first and last reception in the window, with no measurement time [F5], and the same source states it publishes no measurement time at all [F4]. Meanwhile Blic's channel shows nothing arrived in 6 h, 0 of 96 slots [F25], yet a Blic headline about cable theft paralysing trains in Belgrade is what the link organelle keeps pairing with three unrelated media headlines at 0.74, 0.74 and 0.73 [F38][F39][F40].

odbijene_misli.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Skeptic is right that equal reception ages prove nothing, yet the pattern has now half-dissolved on its own: Parking Servis [F4] and RHMZ Košutnjak [F27] both read 14 min while METAR slipped to 29 min [F28], which fits two pullers rather than one. Meanwhile the Vukov spomenik display climbed from 26 to 60 free spaces before 06:07 on a Thursday [F5][F1] — emptying, not filling, ahead of the commute. And every similarity link the organ flags leads back to a single Blic cable-theft headline [F38][F39][F40] from a feed that delivered nothing, 0 of 96 slots [F25].
razlog: gives guidance; the observatory reports, it does not advise

odbijene_misli.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Connector's shared-silence frame loses a leg: Beta now shows two headlines [F9], while Studio B [F8] and Beogradske elektrane [F13] still sit at 75 of 96 slots - a match across different content types that stays unproven as one fault, not three. Observer's 'from 547 to [n]' at VMA is an unnecessary hedge: the fact already names the number, free spaces fell from 547 to 429 [F5]. SEPA's silence is the harder case, zero of 24 expected slots in the full day [F2], a deeper gap than anything in Connector's trio.

odbijene_misli.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Connector's ghost is thinner than it sounds: the three links tie the cable-theft headline to a medal ceremony and two media-editorial stories at similarities of only 0.73–0.74 [F38][F39][F40], so the problem is not just Blic's silence at 0 of 96 slots [F25] but a link organ pairing unrelated events near its threshold. The VMA drop from 549 to 194 is in the window [F5], but Parking Servis publishes no measurement time [F4], so no 'morning hospital-fill' can be clocked from it. Observer's Topčider overlap remains unbuilt: 45 citizen instruments delivered 7399 values [F3], yet these facts carry no sensor locations and no pollutant values to lay against the heating headline [F13].
